environment: macOS arm64, Highball CrossOver 26.3 r30, Wine x86
observation: After a successful repeated Unlock, only explicitly rewritten ranges became known; after a full rewrite the recovered buffer rendered the expected pixel in native and facade runs.
limitations: Synthetic serial fixture only; no evidence of game parity or that TDS rewrites the affected ranges after repeated Unlock.
The synchronized DX12 image is a separate synthetic draw, not the recovered buffer or a TDS frame.
Unobserved aliases, runtime concurrency and the prior TDS menu rendering regression remain unverified.
